verdicts.reason: A is broken: the cream circle has been pulled away from the bottle and now sits behind the 'B' of the headline, which is an obvious collision. The bottle loses its badge backdrop, the pill buttons have turned into square-cornered rectangles (off brand), and the NEW and Try It buttons sit on unrelated, ragged x-positions, leaving dead space top-right. B keeps the bottle-in-circle badge, the rounded pill buttons and a clear top-down order. The pills share a right edge, but the headline is left-aligned, so the two blocks don't line up. B's flaws: the bottle cap touches the top edge and sticks out of its circle, a stray faint circle sits in the corner, and the bottom-left is left empty.
